note: Produced by scripts/activity5-evidence.js against a throwaway copy of CafeMS. Actual results are read from the page.

cases.input: Name, mobile number, date and time left empty; Request my table pressed
cases.expected: Form is not sent; a message appears under each empty required field
cases.actual: 4 messages shown: rName: Your name is required. | rPhone: Mobile number is required. | rDate: Date is required. | rTime: Time is required. Requests sent to the server: 0

cases.feature: Public reservation form – lengths, formats and ranges
cases.input: Name "A", mobile "12345", a date 3 days ago, time 07:30, 25 guests, notes of 170 characters (maxlength bypassed in DevTools)
cases.expected: Each field shows its own message: name too short, mobile format, past date, opening hours, guest range, notes too long
cases.actual: 6 messages shown: rName: Your name must be at least 2 characters. | rPhone: Enter the mobile number as 03XXXXXXXXX (11 digits, starting with 03). | rDate: Date cannot be in the past. | rTime: Choose a time between 10:00 and 23:00. | rParty: Guests must be a whole number from 1 to 20. | rNotes: Notes must be 160 characters or fewer. Requests sent: 0

cases.feature: Public reservation form – leading and trailing spaces removed
cases.input: Name "   Ayesha    Khan   ", mobile " 0321-1234567 ", valid date, time and guests
cases.expected: Spaces are trimmed (and doubled spaces collapsed) before sending; booking is accepted
cases.actual: Confirmation: "Thank you. We've received your request and will confirm your table soon.". Sent to the server: name "Ayesha Khan", mobile "03211234567", notes start "

cases.input: Username and password left empty; Sign in pressed
cases.expected: Nothing is sent; "Enter your username." and "Enter your password." appear
cases.actual: 2 messages shown: username: Enter your username. | password: Enter your password.

cases.feature: Staff reservation form (reservation.html) – required fields and party size
cases.input: Guest name, mobile and time empty, party size 0
cases.expected: Four messages, one under each field; the reservation is not created
cases.actual: 4 messages shown: guestName: Guest name is required. | guestPhone: Mobile number is required. | reservationTime: Reservation time is required. | partySize: Party size must be a whole number from 1 to 20.

cases.feature: Staff reservation form – messages clear when fixed
cases.input: Valid name, mobile "0300 7654321", date, time and party size 3
cases.expected: All messages disappear and the reservation is created
cases.actual: 0 messages left; toast: "R-1002 created for Bilal Ahmed"

cases.feature: Reservation queue (reservations.html) – stored notes shown to staff
cases.input: Guest notes submitted on the public form:
cases.expected: The notes appear as plain text; no image or script element is created, no alert opens, window.__xss stays unset
cases.actual: Shown as text: " " (child elements inside the paragraph: 0). window.__xss: not set; injected : 0; injected

cases.feature: Unsafe DOM APIs are refused by the browser (Trusted Types) and by CMS.h
cases.input: From the page: element.innerHTML = ''; CMS.h('a', { href: 'javascript:alert(1)' }); CMS.h('button', { onclick: 'alert(1)' })
cases.expected: innerHTML with a plain string throws; javascript: links are replaced; a string handler is ignored
cases.actual: innerHTML: TypeError: Failed to set the 'innerHTML' property on 'Element': This document requires 'TrustedHTML' assignment; href became "about:blank#blocked" (with a hidden tab: "about:blank#blocked"); onclick attribute: not set; alerts opened: 0

cases.input: Developer tools → Application: sessionStorage, localStorage and document.cookie read after signing in and using the app
cases.expected: No password, token, code or customer number; localStorage empty; the session cookie is invisible to scripts (HttpOnly)
cases.actual: sessionStorage: {"cms_session":"{\"user\":\"activity.manager\",\"name\":\"Activity Manager\",\"role\":\"Manager\",\"loginAt\":\"2026-11-11T11:08:26.676Z\"}"}; localStorage: {}; document.cookie: ""; sensitive words found: none

cases.feature: Unneeded items in browser storage are removed
cases.input: localStorage.password and sessionStorage.authToken planted from the console, then the next page opened
cases.expected: Both are removed on page load; only cms_session (name, username, role, sign-in time) remains
cases.actual: localStorage items: 0; authToken: removed; sessionStorage keys: cms_session

cases.feature: No secret keys or credentials in frontend JavaScript
cases.input: 7 scripts loaded by the Manager overview page scanned for private keys, API keys, server secrets and database passwords
cases.expected: None found
cases.actual: None found in 7 scripts

cases.feature: Sign out clears the temporary state
cases.input: Sign out pressed and confirmed, then the overview page opened again
cases.expected: cms_session removed, nothing in localStorage, the server session ends (401), and the protected page sends the user back to sign in
cases.actual: sessionStorage keys after sign-out: none; localStorage items: 0; /auth/me now returns 401; opening overview.html ended on /login.html; message: "You have been signed out."
